scripts.build:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:views && npm run build -w @atlas/server
scripts.build:node: npm run build:protocol && npm run build -w @atlas/node
scripts.build:web: npm run build:views && npm run build -w @atlas/web
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:views && npm run build -w @atlas/server && npm run build -w @atlas/node && npm run build -w @atlas/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:server && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:node: npm run build:node && node --import tsx --test test/remote-node.test.ts test/node-identity.test.ts test/workspace-dev.test.ts test/workspaces.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts && npm run test:web
